nodes.name: Webhook /whatsapp
nodes.notes: Webhook compatible Twilio (form) ou Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (JSON). Parse les deux formats.

parameters.jsCode:
// Construit le log row pour les unauthorized.
const inp = $('Auth & parse intent').first().json;
return [{ json: { log: {
  id: 'wa_' + Date.now(),
  ts: new Date().toISOString(),
  direction: 'inbound',
  from_number: inp.log?.from || inp.from || '',
  to_number: '',
  member_id: '',
  intent: 'auth_failed',
  raw_message: inp.log?.raw_message || inp.raw_message || '',
  parsed_args: '',
  response: 'Numéro non autorisé.',
  status: 'denied',
  error: '',
  trace_id: ''
} } }];
